# Fengshui Balance (fengshuibalance.vercel.app)

> Modern luxury Fengshui consultation by Ajarn Suppachai Vivattanaprasert.

Fengshui Balance is a public website for residential, commercial, spirit-house, and Chinese astrology Fengshui guidance in Thailand.
